newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Vivus trades higher.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Vivus trades higher.

text.p: Vivus Inc was trading sharply higher in after-hours action Tuesday after it reported a first quarter net profit of $0.54 per share compared to a loss of $0.45 a year ago, traders said.
"Our last trade was at 44-1/2," one dealer said. "That's up 3-1/8 from the close."
Vivus had closed at 41-3/8, up 3-3/8 for the day during regular trading hours.
Vivus makes therapeutic systems to treat impotence.
Trading down after the bell was Merck and Co Inc, which had closed 1-1/4 lower at 85-1/4 but later traded at 84.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume was 176,600, compared to 4,500 on Monday. Session two volume was 1,694,400, while on Monday it was 366,945.
